title: test suite does not cover newState after truncation
description: test_contact_changes_max_changes_truncation checks hasMoreChanges=true and total item count <= maxChanges but does not assert the value of newState after truncation. As a result, the newState paging bug (see sibling issue) is not caught by any test. A new test is needed with oracle: when 3 changes exist and maxChanges=1, calling again with the returned newState as sinceState must still yield the remaining 2 changes.
